headline: CIN @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CIN 4.06 at CLE 5.04, with a projected total of 9.10. Batter research is strongest for Spencer Steer, Elly De La Cruz, JJ Bleday, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Nathaniel Lowe, Rhys Hoskins because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
